subject: Coordinated release orchestration: exceptions, docs owners, and training rollcall
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, sarah.kim@acme-ops.com
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coordinated release orchestration: exceptions, docs owners, and training rollcall

Team —

Quick note as we lock dates for the Runtime v2 rollout: we have two outstanding asks from product that change the gating for a subset of customers (exceptions for older tokenization paths and a small policy tweak for telemetry opt-in). I want to make sure we have explicit owners for the exception matrix, the enablement deck, and the training slots so we don't miss any compliance or partner approvals.

Action items I want to land this week:
- Ownership: who will take the exception matrix (legal/ops inputs) -> produce a final list of customers + approved mitigation?
- Doc owners: who will take the enablement slide deck and the quick-start snippets for CS?
- Training: Evelyn, can you confirm two 45-min training slots for CS and SEs next week (time windows below)?

Background: Acme Ops flagged a compliance check for customers in their region and wants the exception plan before we start warm-up on cluster A on 4/10. See the draft matrix attached.

Attachments: launch_exception_matrix.xlsx

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Launch Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, sarah.kim@acme-ops.com
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordinated release orchestration: exceptions, docs owners, and training rollcall

Soojin —

I can own the exception matrix from a sales/contracting perspective. I need a concrete list of which customers are in scope (prod vs. pilot) and the permissible mitigation language (I don't want us promising anything legal hasn't signed off on). Two quick notes:

1) SLA/Capacity implications: the older tokenization path increases peak memory usage by ~8% on cluster A based on our tests. Ops will want a clear rollback trigger. If we push exceptions to >25 customers in the same region we risk capacity contention.
2) Pricing/credits: some customers will ask for credits if we route them through the compatibility shim; recommend we pre-authorize 1 week of prorated credits for pilot accounts.

I will draft the customer-facing exception wording and circulate for legal review. Marcus — can you paste the perf numbers for the shim here?

-ben
Ben Carter
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordinated release orchestration: exceptions, docs owners, and training rollcall

Ben / Soojin —

Perf summary for the compatibility shim (short version):
- Avg memory delta: +8–10% for 1K token requests with heavy tokenization edge cases
- 95th latency change: +12 ms on t4-equivalent hosts when shim is engaged
- Suggested rollback trigger: sustained 5-minute CPU or memory >85% on any node in cluster A after deployment

I've uploaded a living doc with the telemetry flags, perf curves, and a recommended mitigation checklist: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2b-ops-launch-playbook

Docs: I can take the quick-start snippets and add the troubleshooting bullets. I propose we split the enablement deck: Evelyn handles CS-facing flows, Marcus will do SE/engineering playbook pages.

Attaching the initial enablement deck draft (enablement_slide_deck_v1.pdf) for review — please annotate before EOD Wednesday.

-marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Product Ops Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordinated release orchestration: exceptions, docs owners, and training rollcall

All —

I can run the CS training. Two constraints: next week I have back-to-back onboarding mornings (PDT). Propose the training windows:
- Wed 4/11 16:00–16:45 PDT (good for EU attendees)
- Thu 4/12 09:00–09:45 PDT (US-focused, early APAC overlap)

I'll prepare the CS flow deck and do a 30-min Q&A. Please send me any customer scenarios you want covered by Tuesday EOD. Also, I flagged one doc gap: we need a short troubleshooting FAQ for the compatibility shim (customer-facing language). Marcus — can you add a 1-page troubleshooting snippet to the Drive doc?

Evelyn Hart
Principal Customer Enablement | Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, sarah.kim@acme-ops.com, cloud-gov@partners.io
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordinated release orchestration: exceptions, docs owners, and training rollcall

Thanks everyone — summary and owners (please reply only if something needs to change):

Owners and deliverables (due Wed 4/04 EOD):
- Exception matrix & customer wording -> Ben Carter (draft + send to legal)
- Troubleshooting snippet (1 page) -> Marcus Lin (add to Drive doc)
- CS-facing enablement deck and training session -> Evelyn Hart (deliver slides + run sessions 4/11 & 4/12)
- SE playbook snippets & quick-start -> Marcus Lin
- Final enablement_slide_deck_v1.pdf annotated by all -> everyone (annotate in Drive)

Operational notes:
- Rollback trigger: Marcus suggested memory/CPU thresholds; Ops will confirm exact alert thresholds by Friday.
- Credits: pre-authorize up to 1 week of prorated credits for pilot customers; Ben will circulate a proposed template for approvals.
- Compliance: Sarah (Acme) asked for the exception list before we start warm-up on 4/10; she is copied. Partners (cloud-gov) want the telemetry flag names — Marcus shared the Drive link above.

Attachments: launch_exception_matrix.xlsx, enablement_slide_deck_v1.pdf
Links: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2b-ops-launch-playbook

I will escalate any blockers to Lauren by Friday morning. If no objections, we'll proceed with the warm-up schedule for 4/10 and hold the first training on 4/11.

Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Launch Programs | Redwood Inference
